__how_to_use: Copy this file to profiles.local.json. Every key below starts with __ , and keys starting with __ are ignored as comments -- so this file does NOTHING until you remove the __ prefix from the part you actually want. Keep only what THIS machine changes; everything else keeps following the shared profiles.json, so new protocols still arrive with a git pull. Anything defined here shows as [local] in the control panel dropdown.
